record.question: The nurse taking care of a patient with chest tube drainage suddenly notices that there is no fluctuation in the water seal tube. Which of the following action should the nurse take first?
options: Turn the patient to the unaffected side
Check the tubing to ensure there is no kinking
record.explanation: Answer C: Check the tubing to ensure there is no kinking. First inspect the drainage system for kinking or obstruction when water-seal fluctuation stops; absence can also reflect lung re-expansion, so assess the patient and system before intervention. Source/context note: A sudden change requires patient assessment and escalation if symptoms or obstruction are present; do not milk the tube. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK459199/. India renamed the Revised National Tuberculosis Control Programme (RNTCP) as the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP) to align with the elimination goal. Reference: https://tbcindia.mohfw.gov.in/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.

record.question: In cold chain process, the walk-in coolers stores vaccine upto:
record.explanation: Answer B: 3 months. Indian vaccine logistics guidance commonly assigns a walk-in cooler to vaccine storage for up to three months at higher-level stores; district/PHC equipment have shorter storage norms. Source/context note: Storage duration depends on level, equipment, stock rotation, and specific operational guideline.
